title: AI — seventy years to arrive, two months to be everywhere
style: documentary photograph, twentieth century laboratory and press archive, hard directional light, cold grey and steel, fine grain, no text, no watermark

lines.vo: In 1956, ten men spent a summer inventing a name for it.
lines.image: an empty lecture room with a blackboard and wooden chairs
lines.title: A NAME FOR IT

shot.signature: we start tight on an empty room and the camera falls back to reveal how little was there — a brass caption is all that marks it

lines.vo: For forty years it mostly lost. Then it beat Kasparov.
lines.image: a tall black computer cabinet in a museum hall
lines.artefact: a close view of a black server cabinet, cable ports and vents
artefactCommons: Deep Blue computer Computer History Museum
caption: Forty years
of losing.

shot.signature: we fly into the photograph of the machine and a hand-drawn outline closes around it as we land

lines.vo: In 2012 it learned to see, and nobody outside the labs noticed.
lines.image: shelves of archive boxes holding thousands of photographs

shot.signature: one slow push down an endless aisle with nothing drawn on it at all — the shot that lets the others land

lines.vo: In 2016 it played a move no human would have played.
lines.image: a wooden board covered in black and white stones
lines.artefact: a close overhead view of a Go board mid-game, black and white stones
caption: Move
thirty-seven.

shot.signature: we land inside the board and a diamond draws itself around one stone

lines.vo: Then it learned to talk, and a hundred million people arrived.
lines.image: a dark room lit only by a screen
lines.title: 100 MILLION
lines.footer: the fastest anything has ever spread

shot.signature: the front page lands over the whole frame and the room keeps pushing past it — the number is the shot

lines.vo: Seventy years to arrive. Two months to be everywhere.
lines.image: a crowded street where everyone is looking down at a phone
lines.title: SEVENTY YEARS

shot.signature: the verdict on a hard card, the crowd pulled back and dimmed behind it
